declaration.preface: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to integrating sustainability into every aspect of its procurement practices. This Sustainable Procurement Policy outlines our approach to sourcing materials and services responsibly—emphasizing environmental protection, ethical labor practices, and long-term economic and social value. By collaborating with suppliers who share our sustainability vision, Alchem aims to minimize its environmental impact, promote fair business conduct, and contribute to a more sustainable global supply chain.
declaration.declaration: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all procurement activities contribute positively to the environment, society, and the local economies in which we operate.
declaration.scope: This policy is applicable across all Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. facilities, offices, research centers, and manufacturing units, as well as all employees, workers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and business partners. It also extends to the communities in which we operate, ensuring that our commitment to environmental responsibility and sustainability is embedded across our global value chain. By including our suppliers and other stakeholders, we seek to promote sustainable practices beyond our own operations and drive positive environmental and social impact throughout the industry.

Environmental Responsibility in Procurem: Alchem International strives to reduce the environmental impact of its procurement processes by partnering with suppliers who demonstrate strong environmental performance. We prioritize suppliers that:
Use renewable, recyclable, or eco-friendly materials in their products and packaging.
Adopt energy-efficient technologies to minimize greenhouse gas emissions.
Implement waste reduction and responsible waste management systems.
Ensure efficient water usage and promote sustainable water conservation practices.
Labor Practices and Human Rights: Alchem International upholds the highest standards of labor and human rights across its supply chain. We expect our suppliers and partners to:
Comply with all applicable labor and employment laws, including fair wages, working hours, and benefits.
Provide a safe, healthy, and respectful work environment for all employees.
Prohibit child labor, forced labor, and any form of human trafficking.
Foster diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring fair and non-discriminatory practices.
Ethical Sourcing and Fair Trade: Alchem International promotes ethical sourcing and supports fair-trade practices throughout its supply network. We aim to collaborate with suppliers who:
Provide fair compensation and maintain transparent labor practices.
Support small producers and cooperatives aligned with fair-trade standards.
Operate with integrity, accountability, and respect for ethical business conduct.
Supplier Engagement and Development: Alchem International believes in building long-term, responsible partnerships. We work closely with suppliers to strengthen their sustainability capabilities through:
Regular engagement, dialogue, and feedback mechanisms.
Capacity-building programs and technical training to improve ESG performance.
Collaborative initiatives that drive continuous improvement and alignment with global sustainability standards.
Supplier Assessment: Alchem conducts detailed evaluations of suppliers’ environmental impact, labor practices, and human rights compliance through documentation reviews, site visits, and third-party certifications. These assessments ensure that all partners meet Alchem’s high ESG standards and maintain responsible business practices.
Supplier Code of Conduct: Alchem’s Supplier Code of Conduct defines clear expectations regarding sustainability, ethical labor, and human rights. All suppliers are required to sign and comply with this code, which is periodically updated to align with global standards. Continued partnership depends on full adherence to these principles.
Capacity Building and Collaboration: Alchem supports suppliers through training programs, workshops, and shared best practices on topics like energy efficiency, waste reduction, and fair labor. Collaborative engagement fosters mutual growth, strengthens supplier capabilities, and enhances overall supply chain sustainability.
Regular Audits and Corrective Action: Routine audits are conducted—especially for high-risk suppliers—to monitor compliance with sustainability and ethical standards. Any non-compliance must be addressed through corrective action plans, and repeated violations may lead to suspension or contract termination. This process ensures accountability and continuous improvement across the supply chain.
Communication and Transparency: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd.’s Sustainable Procurement Policy will be published on the company’s official website and shared with all suppliers, contractors, and business partners to ensure openness and accessibility.

Alchem will ensure that all employees involved in procurement receive regular training on sustainable procurement principles. This will empower them to make responsible sourcing decisions and engage effectively with suppliers on sustainability and ethical performance expectations.
Continuous Improvement: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to continuously enhancing its procurement practices to strengthen sustainability and ethical standards across the supply chain. As global sustainability priorities and market dynamics evolve, Alchem will regularly review and update its policies, collaborate closely with suppliers, and adopt innovative solutions to ensure the company remains a leader in responsible and sustainable sourcing.

targets.target: Ensure 75% of suppliers comply with Alchem’s environmental sustainability standards
Achieve a 20% reduction in supply chain carbon emissions through the procurement of energy-efficient materials and services
Increase the use of renewable or recycled materials by 20% across all procurement categories

quantitative.area: Labor Practices and Human Rights in Procurement

targets.target: Conduct 100% audits of high-risk suppliers to verify compliance with labor laws and human rights standards
Ensure 100% supplier compliance with Alchem’s fair wage, safe working condition, and labor rights requirements
Ensure that at least 50% of goods sourced from developing regions meet recognized fair trade or equivalent ethical sourcing standards
Ensure 100% of suppliers undergo annual sustainability assessments and audits to evaluate their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance.
Source 100% of goods and services from suppliers holding recognized sustainability certifications such as ISO 14001, Fair Trade, or equivalent standards.
Provide annual sustainability training and resources to 100% of suppliers to strengthen their ability to meet Alchem’s environmental and social performance expectations.
Commit to sourcing 25% of goods and services from local or community-based suppliers to support regional economies and reduce the company’s overall carbon footprint.

responsibilities.duty: The CPO holds overall responsibility for implementing the Sustainable Procurement Policy and ensuring that all procurement strategies align with Alchem International’s sustainability goals and ethical sourcing principles. The CPO also oversees the integration of ESG criteria into procurement systems and regularly reviews progress toward defined sustainability targets.

This team works closely with the procurement function to evaluate supplier performance, ensure compliance with sustainability standards, and coordinate regular audits. The team is also responsible for maintaining and updating Alchem’s Supplier Code of Conduct to align with evolving ESG frameworks and regulatory requirements.

Procurement Managers are responsible for embedding sustainability requirements into all procurement decisions. They engage directly with suppliers to verify compliance with Alchem’s environmental, labor, and human rights standards and support suppliers in improving their sustainability performance where needed.

Suppliers are expected to uphold Alchem International’s sustainability standards, including environmental stewardship, ethical labor practices, and responsible sourcing. They must provide transparent reporting on sustainability performance and cooperate fully with audits, assessments, and capacity-building initiatives as part of their partnership with Alchem.

policy.monitoring:
Supplier Performance Reports: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. will prepare regular reports evaluating supplier performance against environmental, labor, and ethical standards. These reports will guide procurement decisions and help drive continuous improvement across the supply chain.

Audit Reports: Findings from supplier audits will be reviewed by the Sustainability and Compliance Team, with any instances of non-compliance promptly addressed through corrective action plans to ensure full alignment with Alchem’s sustainability and ethical sourcing standards.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Sustainable Procurement Policy of Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. will be reviewed annually by the Chief Procurement Officer (CPO) in collaboration with the Sustainability and Compliance Team. The review will assess progress toward established quantitative targets, evaluate supplier performance, and ensure the policy remains effective in addressing emerging sustainability challenges and regulatory developments. Any required revisions or updates will be approved by senior management and communicated to all relevant employees, suppliers, and stakeholders to maintain alignment and transparency.
